title: Keith P NDE 936
content:
I awoke with a leg cramp like so many people have done so many times around the world. I couldn't get this one to stretch out and relax. I headed for the bathroom hoping some hot water in the shower would help relax the muscle. I tried to straighten my body out so I could fit into the shower stall. At that moment, my head started buzzing and I remember trying to sit down on the toilet. The next thing I knew I was back up at about my normal height. At first, I thought I was standing but I was slowly moving without walking. The thing I most remember is the feeling it was like a very gentle very warm wind was on my back pushing me, it also felt like I was enveloped in a feeling of total peace, love, and contentment, a feeling I can only describe as Heaven. In the initial moments I got the impression of others standing around me much like you would experience in a crowded bar but that quickly faded. I remember looking through the bedroom adjacent to the bathroom and down the hall and seeing my wife in the dining area, where we had the computer desk, she was on-line and in a chat room. I then remember her getting up and coming my way and walking directly through me. I was out of the bathroom and in the bedroom at this time. Shortly after that, I woke up on the floor of the bathroom, my wife said she had found my body, and my eyes had been wide open and staring off into space, but I was not breathing. She said my lips and fingers were already blue from the lack of oxygen. She pulled me from the toilet, where I had apparently managed to sit down just beforehand, and began rudimentary CPR once I was on the floor. I would like to add that feeling I described as Heaven was so overpowering that for a short time afterwards I actually resented being revived.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden collapse associated with severe leg cramp and head buzzing; found not breathing and received rudimentary CPR.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: OBE included perceiving wife at the computer and her walking through him; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/transitional peaceful state occurred without a tunnel or light encounter, followed by an abrupt return to the body on the bathroom floor.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Sensation of a 'very gentle very warm wind' pushing him; impression of others around him 'like in a crowded bar' that quickly faded; wife walked directly through him.
